how_to_change: The source owner approves a new or changed label, column, or maximum by merging a pull request that edits this file, then regenerates etl/03_silver and the Silver data dictionary (docs/operations/silver.md). A label that is not listed here fails the Silver gate (labels_mapped_*); a publisher column that is not classified here stops the generator.

identifier.note: Kept as text (fixed six digits). Validated exactly as published, without trimming.

count_groups.note: Every column listed here is a count, typed INT. A blank stays NULL, never 0. A value that is not 1 to 9 digits, or is above its group's plausible_max, quarantines the row. Counts are not trimmed.

buildings.evidence: Largest published value 52 (buildings_needs_minor_repair), SY 2023-24. 200 is 3.8 times that and catches a count with an extra digit (520).

classrooms.evidence: Largest published value 231 (es_classrooms_instructional), SY 2023-24. 1,000 is 4.3 times that and catches a count with an extra digit (2,310).

temporary_and_makeshift.evidence: Largest published value 445 (hs_classes_using_makeshift_rooms), SY 2023-24; the next is 132. 1,000 is 2.2 times that and catches a count with an extra digit (4,450).

booleans.evidence: Every one of the 63 yes/no columns holds only True, False, or blank in SY 2023-24. The offers_* columns are never blank; the 60 facility columns are 22.6% to 82.3% filled among public schools (34.6% to 96.1% blank overall). Enrollment's Yes/No (SY 2025-26) is not listed: facilities has no such year yet.

sector.rule: Same standard set as deped_enrollment (DepEd's README list).

school_management.rule: Same standard set as deped_enrollment (its SY 2020-21, 2023-24, and 2024-25 labels). Local Government is in that set for SY 2020-21 enrollment; this SY 2023-24 file does not publish it.

overseas.note: Any marker makes is_overseas TRUE, as in deped_enrollment. Both agree on all 33 rows.

public_scope.evidence: SY 2023-24: of 12,349 non-public rows (Private 12,113, SUC/LUC 203, PSO 33), none has a value in any of the 81 facility columns; every public row but one has at least one. Technical Notes p. 3, 12: facility data covers public schools. All rows stay in Silver; Gold scopes to public schools. A non-public row with a facility value is WARN (facility_data_public_only): the scope may have changed.

missing_classrooms.evidence: 669 of 39,346 public schools offering elementary have a blank es_classrooms_instructional, and no school has 0. 466 of the 669 report a temporary learning space or makeshift room above 0, so a blank may mean zero permanent rooms (S-2, open). Kept NULL and flagged es_classrooms_missing; never read as 0.

levels.note: A facility column's prefix names the school level it describes; buildings_* describe the whole school. hs_ covers junior and senior high. A value for a level the school does not offer is WARN (facility_values_within_offered_levels): Gold reads a blank there as 'not applicable'.
levels.evidence: SY 2023-24: 0 rows have a value for a level the school does not offer.

location.evidence: SY 2023-24: 60,167 school IDs in both files; 0 only in facilities; 0 only in enrollment.
location.rule: Facilities has no place columns: its location comes from deped_enrollment_clean through (school_id, school_year). Facilities Silver does not read enrollment, so the two lanes run in parallel; Integration (#91), after 90_validate_control, checks that every facilities school is in enrollment.
